name: Mercedes-AMG Team ART
history: ART Grand Prix from Villeneuve-la-Guyard in France. Founded in 2005 by Frédéric Vasseur and Nicolas Todt. Nico Rosberg and Lewis Hamilton won the GP2 title with the team in 2005 and 2006. Joins the DTM in 2015 as the third Mercedes team.
detail: Announced 2014-11-29 after the 2014 season. In 2015 the cars ran as Euronics/BWT Mercedes-AMG.
Last season 2016. Mercedes cut to 6 cars all run by HWA.
Last season 2016. Mercedes ended its DTM work with Mücke.
Last season 2016. MTEK moved to the BMW GTE programme.
Last season 2016. Schnitzer moved to GT racing.
Last season 2016. Abt went from 2 teams to 1.

name: BMW Team RMR
history: A shared BMW crew of Team RMG and Team RBM. RMR stands for Reinhold Mampaey Racing. Stefan Reinhold and Bart Mampaey run it together. First DTM season in 2017.
detail: BMW kept 6 cars in 3 teams of 2. Exact announcement date not found.

name: Mercedes-AMG Motorsport SILBERPFEIL Energy
history: The third HWA team from Affalterbach. From 2017 HWA runs all six Mercedes cars. The team carries the name of the SILBERPFEIL Energy drink.
detail: Mercedes confirmed 6 HWA cars on 2016-10-27.
Last season 2018. Mercedes left the DTM for Formula E. Announced 2017-07-24.
Last season 2018. Mercedes left the DTM for Formula E.
Last season 2018. Mercedes left the DTM for Formula E.
Mercedes left after 2018.

name: HWA AFR Turbo 2.0
detail: HWA built the engine of the Aston Martin Vantage DTM (AFR Turbo 2.0). Engine name only checked on Wikipedia.

name: R-Motorsport
history: Swiss team from Niederwil near St. Gallen, owned by Florian Kamelger and Andreas Bänziger. It is the racing arm of the Aston Martin dealer in St. Gallen and raced Aston Martin GT3 cars in the Blancpain GT Series. Brings Aston Martin to the DTM in 2019 with the Vantage DTM built by HWA.
detail: Announced 2018-10-11 after the 2018 season. 4 cars in 2 teams.

name: R-Motorsport 2
history: The second R-Motorsport team from Switzerland. Runs the Aston Martin Vantage DTM built by HWA. Shares its base in Niederwil with R-Motorsport.
detail: Announced 2018-10-11 after the 2018 season.

name: Audi Sport Team WRT
history: W Racing Team from Belgium. Founded in 2009 by Vincent Vosse, René Verbist and Yves Weerts. Won the Spa 24 Hours with Audi in 2011 and 2014. The first Audi customer team in the DTM from 2019.
detail: Announced 2018-10-12 after the 2018 season. Went to 3 cars in 2020.
Last season 2019. Split from HWA and withdrew on 2020-01-24.
Last season 2019.
No Aston Martin cars after 2019.

name: Orlen Team ART
history: ART Grand Prix returns to the DTM in 2020, now with BMW. Runs one customer BMW M4 for Robert Kubica. The Polish fuel company Orlen backs the team.
detail: Announced 2020-02-13.
